title: Cheaply Made - Arrived Broken - Do Not Recommend
text: Cheaply Made - Arrived Broken - Do Not Recommend. Very cheaply made and arrived broken.  I needed them for an important event the next day so I salvaged a couple that could be used.  Even those broke when used.  Pass on by and go with another vendor.
